# quantized.uk

> LLM quantization intelligence for developers running models on consumer hardware.

## What this site is

- Static reference site (no model hosting, no accounts)
- 79+ quantized LLM index with VRAM, speed, and quality metadata
- RSS updates feed: https://quantized.uk/feed.xml
- Full Chinese edition at /zh/ (same content, hreflang-paired): https://quantized.uk/zh/
- Tools: VRAM calculator, format wizard, CLI generator, model compare
- 23 deployment cookbook guides (llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, Docker, WSL2)
- Real-hardware benchmarks (RTX 4090/3090, Apple Silicon)

## Key URLs

- Home: https://quantized.uk/ (Chinese: https://quantized.uk/zh/)
- Model index: https://quantized.uk/quant-hub/
- VRAM calculator: https://quantized.uk/tools/vram-calc/
- Cookbook: https://quantized.uk/cookbook/
- Benchmarks: https://quantized.uk/benchmarks/
- About: https://quantized.uk/about/
- Sitemap: https://quantized.uk/sitemap.xml
- Feed: https://quantized.uk/feed.xml

## Languages

- English at the root: https://quantized.uk/
- Chinese (Simplified) under /zh/: https://quantized.uk/zh/
- Language is carried by the URL, not a cookie or toggle state. Every page has a
  hreflang-paired mirror in the other tree, and both are prerendered — the
  Chinese text is in the HTML, not swapped in by JavaScript.

## Contact

No public source repository link on the site. Feedback: hello@quantized.uk. See /about/ for maintenance and update policy.
